title: Technology in Daily Life
grammar: Future and Obligatory Participle (-andó/-endő) in Technology
goal: I can contrast then and now with míg … addig.
I can say that something became or is becoming something using vált and -vá/-vé.
I can use távmunka, digitális írástudás, automatizálás and mindennapi rutin.
